title: 52TOYS lists four blind-box series in its November 13 new arrivals
summary: 52TOYS's international storefront new-arrivals page dates four in-scope listings November 13, 2026: Cat Swing (USD 7.99 single box; 4-box set separately), Cat Cat PAI Happy Unbreakable Spin (USD 5.99 single box; 6-box set), LuLu the Piggy Animal Party Vol. 2 (USD 18.99 single box; 8-box set), and Teddy LuLu Colorful Life (USD 18.99 single box; 6-box set). Prices were observed with United States selected on November 15. Set totals have not been verified. November 13 is the retailer new-arrival date, not proof of an original launch, mainland-China price/stock or sales growth. No catalog additions are asserted by this news item.

title: POP MART schedules THE MONSTERS crystal-ball blind-box series for November 12
summary: POP MART's official U.S. product page specifies November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific as the online release date for WHERE WISHES COME TRUE SERIES - Crystal Ball Blind Box. Six regular styles and one secret are pictured; stated materials include PVC, ABS, silicone, electronic components, metal, silica glass and water.
